Nora (CS): hey team! starting my CS rotation today. need HubSpot support seat, Dialpad softphone, and the condensed CS<>Sales playbook. who do i holler at? cc @Aditi
Aditi (Sales): welcome Nora :tada: i'll forward the priority account list. ping Tom for seats, or open a ticket. quick note: include 'Gong listen' if you want call recordings.
Nora (CS): thanks — for HubSpot can i get just the support role or should i ask for edit access to deals too?
Tom (IT): hey Nora — we provision Support role by default. if you need deal edits, request "support_plus" and justify with examples. fastest way is the ticket portal or the slash command:
```
/seat-request product=hubspot role=support_user user=nora@redwood.ai reason="CS rotation - need contact edit + notes"
```
Dialpad:
```
/seat-request product=dialpad seat=softphone user=nora@redwood.ai location=home_office
```
Add "headset=true" if you need hardware.
Nora (CS): perfect. what's the canonical CS handoff doc — short one?
Ravi (Ops): short playbook is here: https://drive.redwood.ai/CS/quick-handoff-one-pager.pdf — covers who owns onboarding steps, sample intros, and the 'first-week outreach' templates.
Aditi (Sales): i'll DM you the Gong folder and the sales->cs checklist. small tip: mark the ticket with account tier so CS knows SLA.
Nora (CS): can someone paste the first-week email template? want to add to Gong sequence now.
Maya (CS Lead): paste incoming — modify name and timing:
"Hi {{first_name}},

I'm Nora from Redwood Customer Success — excited to work with you. I'll be your point for onboarding and setup. Quick question: do you have the integration keys ready or should I schedule a setup call?

Best,
Nora"
Nora (CS): nice, i'll slot into CS-Onboard sequence. one more q — who owns follow-up cadences for trial accounts?
Aditi (Sales): Sales seeds the sequence but CS owns week0/week1 check-ins after handoff.
seat-bot: Ticket #4729 opened: HubSpot (support_user), Dialpad (softphone), Gong listen. ETA: 24 hours.
Nora (CS): thanks all — i'll wait for provisioning then book a 30m sync to go through top three accounts. i'm free 09:30-11:00 PT tomorrow.
Aditi (Sales): 10:00 PT works, invite sent.
Maya (CS Lead): i'll join and review the escalation paths. welcome aboard! :raised_hands:
